module_summary: Five-state Moore FSM scanning a serial bit stream for 1101, then locking in Done and asserting start_shifting until reset.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: 3-bit sequence-detector state register tracking 1101 prefix progress, sticky Done state.

anchors.name: start_shifting
anchors.why: Level output decoded from Done state; stays high until reset.

groups.name: sequence_detector
groups.description: Next-state logic on data bit plus state register detecting 1101 and flagging start.
